name: Texas Hold'em
tagline: No-limit poker. Two hole cards, five on the board, all the chips.
rulesSummary: Win everyone's chips. Run out and you're out; the last player with chips wins.
The two players left of the dealer post the small and big blinds (with two players, the dealer posts the small one). Everyone gets two cards face down.
Four rounds of betting: before the flop, after the flop (3 shared cards), after the turn (1 more) and after the river (1 more). Fold, check, call, bet or raise.
No limit: bet up to all your chips. A raise is at least the big blind, or the last raise. All in for less? You can only win what you matched (a side pot).
Your hand is the best five of seven cards: your two plus the board. Use both, one or neither.
Best to worst: straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, high card. Aces are high, or low in A-2-3-4-5.
The last player in, or the best hand at the showdown, takes the pot. Ties split it.
